scope: current evidence audit; no historical assessment rewritten

records.label: Account for complete annual, quarterly and semi-annual disclosure packages, including notes and relevant referenced material. U1, U3.
records.original_obligation: Define the source inventory, coverage units, cross-reference closure and disposition rules. A worked filing package must account for retained, structured, duplicated and unresolved content without treating page extraction as semantic completion.

records.label: Preserve numeric meaning: entities, perimeter, concept, dimensions, currency, units, scale, sign, basis and precision. U1, D.
records.original_obligation: Complete context/value types and compatibility rules, with valid/invalid examples and faithful rendering of the original disclosed amounts.

records.label: Represent narrative policies, qualifications, commitments and cross-references, including material that is not executable yet. U1, U3, D.
records.original_obligation: Specify narrative assertion types, modality/quantifiers, links to affected amounts and obligations, and reviewed translation into constraints without inventing thresholds.

records.label: Separate reported assertions, extraction readings, derivations, assumptions and conflicts. U1, U2, P, D.
records.original_obligation: Define source/derived/assumed status propagation and conflict handling; show both extraction error and a genuinely conflicting disclosure without silently changing either source.

records.label: Represent economic, reporting, publication/availability and system times; preserve original and revised history. U1, U3, D.
records.original_obligation: Specify original, latest-available and harmonised queries, cutoffs, supersession, calendar/interval rules and retrospective/prospective changes. Include exact annual/interim/restatement fixtures.

records.label: Distinguish legal entities, ownership, control, group perimeter and consolidation. U1, D.
records.original_obligation: Provide dated entity/control and adjustment-book types, acquisition/disposal and intragroup examples, and rules preventing unexplained consolidation plugs.

records.label: Align differing company labels and overlapping dimensions without equating unlike measurements or double counting. U1, D.
records.original_obligation: Specify concept/mapping relationships, applicability and aggregation rules; demonstrate company extensions and product/geography totals over the same population.

records.label: Preserve jointly consistent discrete alternatives and continuous unknowns across accounts, notes and dates. U2, D.
records.original_obligation: Define history-family and choice/constraint semantics; provide cases preserving linked alternatives and rejecting incompatible combinations without independent account-by-account selection.

records.label: Construct historical families through a specified method, with honest scope and search completeness. U2, U3, D.
records.original_obligation: Define candidate templates, model-scope records, instantiation and constraint lowering, feasible/infeasible/unknown results, truncation and coverage evidence.

records.label: Distinguish uncertainty about facts, disclosure readings, admissible accounting treatment, estimates, behaviour and future shocks. U2, P, D.
records.original_obligation: Specify the categories, dependencies and admissibility checks; show why a factual unknown, permitted election and unsupported treatment cannot be substituted for one another.

records.label: Preserve the economic memory and scenario responses needed when histories are aggregated or refined. U2, D.
records.original_obligation: Define required state by contract/lot/cohort, permitted grouping transformations, supported horizon/scenarios, exact versus approximate status and invalidation when the query changes.

records.label: Add probabilities only under an explicit justified joint measure, and retain unweighted alternatives when weights are unsupported. U2, P, D.
records.original_obligation: Specify optional weight/prior/likelihood records, dependence, overlaps, updates and mass preservation; provide a worked weighted and unweighted example with clear interpretation.

records.label: Drive economic events from contract state and explicit behaviour, then apply accounting rules and atomic journal/state updates. U2, D.
records.original_obligation: Specify one reference economic model, event payloads, recognition/measurement operations, preconditions, ordering and atomic transitions. Prove the stated bookkeeping invariant and separately define admissibility.

records.label: Give scenarios and decision information explicit meanings. U2, P, D.
records.original_obligation: Define supported exogenous stress, observational-conditioning and intervention modes, or explicitly scope unsupported modes; enforce information dates and distinguish real-world from pricing measures.

records.label: Specify ordinary corporate operations and accounting across periods. U1, U2, U3, D.
records.original_obligation: Provide a bounded coherent package for revenue/collections, purchases/payments, inventory/costs, assets/depreciation, payroll, financing and applicable closing/tax assumptions, with explicit exclusions.

records.label: Produce coherent financial statements, movements and supported note schedules from the same underlying history/path. U1, U2, D.
records.original_obligation: Define balance sheet, income/comprehensive income, cash flow and equity mappings, non-cash movements, closing and note relationships; supply a full set of expected outputs.

records.label: Represent financing instruments and their economic/accounting lifecycles, particularly bonds and equity. U1, U2, D.
records.original_obligation: Specify proceeds, principal, carrying/fair values, rates, calendars, maturities, rights and share quantities; work issuance, accrual, settlement and relevant modification/conversion/default cases under declared treatments.

records.label: Preserve joint conditional future outcomes, honest bounds and distinct failure/completeness states. U2, P, D.
records.original_obligation: Define result payloads and queries that retain branch/path dependence, distinguish sampled ranges from certified bounds and distinguish default from unsupported/numerically failed output without silent dropping or renormalisation.

records.label: Accommodate IFRS, US GAAP and China GAAP/ASBE with dated treatments, elections and transitions. U1, U3.
records.original_obligation: Define the supported treatment matrix, rule authority and version selection; show matched economic events under selected genuinely different treatments and identify unimplemented operations.

records.label: Support materially different industry and company concepts without bypassing the common accounting semantics. U1, D.
records.original_obligation: Specify extension points, concept mappings and rule admissibility; include representative industry differences and an invalid company override.

records.label: Represent banks' liabilities, assets, deposits, capital and regulatory/economic constraints. U1, U2.
records.original_obligation: Define core bank structural records now and operation-level later methods for funding, credit, liquidity and capital, including accounting/prudential reconciliation and an appropriate worked case.

records.label: Represent insurers' contract groups, claims, service/finance components, assets and reinsurance. U1, U2.
records.original_obligation: Define cohort/group state and movements, declared measurement approaches and interfaces, reinsurance links and a complete structural/roll-forward example; expand actuarial/accounting support.

records.label: Explain the DSL's role and tradeoffs against credible alternatives, including typed ordinary code, XBRL, ledgers, rule languages and probabilistic tools. U1, U3, P.
records.original_obligation: Tie each claimed benefit to the same concrete tasks and shared semantic requirements; state costs and a fair authoring comparison protocol. Keep empirical superiority unclaimed until evaluated.

records.label: Specify the core language and IR completely enough for compatible independent implementations. U3, D.
records.original_obligation: Provide complete grammar/lexical rules, AST/IR schemas, types, context rules, built-ins, errors, package interfaces and source-to-IR-to-result fixtures, including the demonstration package.

records.label: Specify APIs, adapters, storage, versioning, identity and deterministic recovery. U3, P, D.
records.original_obligation: Define complete arguments/results, state ownership, migration semantics, evidence/model/run identity, event idempotency, random-stream allocation and replay requirements with examples.

records.label: Specify supported numerical/solver operations and their limits. U3, P, D.
records.original_obligation: Define formula fragments, reformulations, exact/approximate monetary treatment, rounding, strict-domain bounds, infeasibility/conflict evidence, timeout and resource behaviour.

records.label: Specify analyst/LLM review and correction as a traceable local workflow. U1, U3, D.
records.original_obligation: Define proposal, acceptance, alternative, rejection and supersession actions, with evidence requirements, consistency checks and derived-result invalidation; show an actual conflict-resolution example.

records.label: Connect the full design through complete synthetic and real disclosure cases. U1, U2, U3, D.
records.original_obligation: Supply a known-history synthetic company and a named annual/interim real package across multiple dates; trace representative notes through records, constraints, alternatives and all affected future statements. Add structural finance/sector cases before fixing the core types.

records.label: Conduct a broad, technically grounded literature survey beyond the original collection. U3, P.
records.original_obligation: Inspect relevant primary methods/theory/evaluation/appendices and official code where available; compare direct alternatives; make genuine backward/forward screening, source-specific omissions, corrections and claim support inspectable.

records.label: Preserve the relevant source library and precise provenance. U3, P.
records.original_obligation: Archive accessible relevant papers under the required naming convention, retain exact versions/anchors, preserve original files, and document unavailable sources without relying on their uninspected claims.

records.label: Survey open-source tools and define evidence-based reuse boundaries. U3, P, D.
records.original_obligation: Inspect official interfaces/licences, identify supported subsets, specify adapter exchanges and version assumptions, and separate inspected capabilities from later integration/performance evidence.

records.label: Deliver a detailed, readable LaTeX/PDF document that governs the intended implementation. U3, P.
records.original_obligation: Explain the whole problem, justify chosen methods, stage mathematical prerequisites, define supported behaviour and disclose open scope; connect derivations and sources to complete examples and interfaces. Preserve mathematical/source fidelity during revisions and inspect the rendered result.

records.label: Define meaningful acceptance and separate engineering, accounting and scientific evidence. U3, P, D.
records.original_obligation: Provide canonical conformance inputs/outputs, corpus/annotation rules, justified release-specific criteria, review status and later forecast baselines/uncertainty protocols. Existing arithmetic/build checks keep their limited meanings.

records.label: Stage implementation without losing the full mission or concealing unresolved decisions. U1, U2, U3, P, D.
records.original_obligation: Maintain requirement-to-section/case/gap traceability, explicit current-versus-later support, dependency order, workload assumptions and open decisions. Re-audit after material changes and test interactions, not just individual rows.

records.label: Complete feasible internal preparation before paid professional review and minimise avoidable reviewer effort. U4.
records.original_obligation: Allocate every residual gap to internal work or a specific professional judgment; supply checked facts, dated sources, a proposed answer, counterargument and consequences before referral. Any later engagement has explicit user authority and an agreed bounded scope/cost. Keep human acceptance separate from continued internal work.

records.label: Reconstruction defines the answer more precisely than the algorithm
records.original_obligation:
specify one bounded reference model, its template registry,
candidate-generation procedure, constraint lowering, scope exclusions,
sufficient-state checks and partial-search semantics. Include exact examples
of an admissible history retained, an incompatible history rejected, and an
economically relevant possibility outside the declared scope. A solver witness
must remain distinct from a coverage claim.

records.label: The normative language and IR contracts remain incomplete
records.original_obligation:
publish the complete Core 0 schema and reference package,
precise typing/context rules and function contracts, serialisation rules and
matched source-to-IR-to-result fixtures. Implementers need reproducible outcomes
for valid and invalid programs, not just agreement on names of operations.

records.label: Ordinary disclosure uncertainty can leave the promised solver fragment
records.original_obligation:
enumerate supported formula classes and solver operations,
including rounding, strict bounds and attainment. Where valid, use a linear
parameterisation: fixed amount F and floating amount V, with F+V=D and F,V
nonnegative; then future interest at known rates is linear in F and V. Specify
when that rewrite is equivalent to the intended model and when additional
fraction restrictions prevent it. Unsupported cases must retain the model and
return a clearly limited answer, with declared computational budgets.

records.label: The first corporate accounting package is an inventory of duties
records.original_obligation:
provide one deliberately bounded corporate profile with an
opening state, event schedules, journal templates and all statement mappings.
Carry it across annual and interim periods, including a correction and one
perimeter or currency case. Every supported operation needs its assumptions,
preconditions, state changes and expected reports; explicit exclusions are
acceptable. A balanced financing illustration does not specify this package.

records.label: No complete filing-to-forecast reference case tests the central workflow
records.original_obligation:
add a complete synthetic fixture whose hidden history is known
and a bounded, named real annual/interim disclosure case. Show representative
notes including narrative qualifications, missing terms, a contradiction and
a revised comparative. A worked specification can be written before the
engine exists; the gap is not simply the absence of production code.

records.label: Forward economic and probability models remain interfaces
records.original_obligation:
specify one transparent scenario/operating baseline and its
information timing. For the optional probabilistic stage, supply a worked
joint model and an evidence-update example. Target-specific calibration is a
later empirical task, not a prerequisite for documenting those methods. P0
need not wait for a full Bayesian engine.

records.label: Standards, banks and insurance are largely deferred requirements
records.original_obligation:
define operation-level scope and primary authority for the
first supported treatments. Add matched cross-standard examples and bank,
insurance and hybrid-instrument record/transition examples. Expand actuarial,
regulatory and accounting literature alongside each method specification.

records.label: Literature breadth exceeds the depth of the follow-up screening
records.original_obligation:
record actual screening decisions for relevant candidates;
use an unreviewed status until a decision exists. Inspect direct competitors,
extensions, corrections and negative findings, expanding each implementation
method's supporting literature. Do not treat the mere existence of six JSON
ledgers as evidence that the literature policy has been satisfied.

records.label: Tool selection is a shortlist, without demonstrated adapter contracts
records.original_obligation:
specify the adapter inputs, outputs, errors and supported
subsets; demonstrate the smallest important exchanges with recorded versions.
An integration spike is an implementation-time check. The design can already
define the expected exchange and fallback without asserting performance or
superiority. Broad benchmarking is unnecessary at this stage.

records.label: Acceptance and completion are not yet determinate
records.original_obligation:
turn the central cases into canonical inputs and expected
outputs; define the initial corpus and review decisions; select justified
release criteria and workload budgets before evaluation. Universal arbitrary
accuracy cutoffs are not needed. Maintain an open-decisions register identifying
what must be settled before each stage can be accepted.

records.label: Whole-report coverage and narrative formalisation need a procedure
records.original_obligation:
one complete filing manifest, source-span disposition and
cross-reference example; typed narrative records; a mapping from disclosures
to supported constraints or explicit unresolved obligations. Preserve separate
coverage meanings and defined denominators. Do not score parsed pages as
formalised financial meaning, or turn "substantially all" into an invented
numeric threshold.

records.label: Cross-company concepts and aggregation need formal mapping semantics
records.original_obligation:
a mapping registry and application rules, with cases where
similar labels mean different measurements and different labels mean the same
quantity. Define what proves a partition disjoint/exhaustive, how unallocated
residuals are represented and how perimeter/context changes affect mappings.
The representation need not impose one universal chart of accounts, but it
must specify how comparability is established or left unresolved.

records.label: Multiple clocks are identified without complete historical query rules
records.original_obligation:
a multi-date example with explicit publication, ingestion,
economic and reporting times, original and revised amounts, and the exact
records/results returned by each supported view. Show invalid year-to-date
subtractions across revisions as well as a valid one. Declare unsupported
timing assumptions rather than silently using the latest available row.

records.label: Scenario modes and permitted information need enforceable contracts
records.original_obligation:
declare supported scenario kinds and represent them in the
schema. A first release can explicitly support exogenous stress only without
claiming the other operations. Show how a manager and an allowance calculation
receive current information while future simulated outcomes remain hidden.
Explain when new observed evidence updates historical weights and why merely
selecting a hypothetical stress does not do so.

records.label: Different kinds of uncertainty need different admissibility rules
records.original_obligation:
define these distinctions in the model and review contracts,
including links between dependent uncertainties. Show an admissible alternative,
an evidence-refuted alternative and an unsupported accounting treatment.
Preserve a possibly erroneous source assertion as evidence without silently
endorsing its treatment. This requires no new fraud-detection product.

records.label: Aggregation and history compression need a practical resolution policy
records.original_obligation:
define resolution metadata, state requirements and a small
set of justified transformations. Include one grouping that preserves the
requested results and another that loses a rate, maturity or guarantee
exposure. Declare the scope/error of approximate aggregation and retain its
source/detail references. Changing the query must trigger a sufficiency check.

records.label: Local evidence review needs a state machine and invalidation rules
records.original_obligation:
a simple local review-state specification and an example
from raw extraction through reviewed alternatives and revised conclusions.
Separate reviewer approval, extraction confidence and probabilities of
economic histories. Preserve previous results against their original evidence
view. Multi-user approval hierarchies are outside the current need.

records.label: Reproducibility needs identity and replay definitions, not only fields
records.original_obligation:
explicit canonicalisation and identity rules, version and
migration contracts, and replay examples covering formatting changes, evidence
corrections, reordered independent events, duplicate event IDs and branch order.
Specify which results must be identical and which numerical comparisons have a
justified tolerance. No new cryptographic-attestation system is implied.
